code:
Given: ~200,000 taxi trips/day, ~500 bytes/event

Trips per second (avg):  200,000 / 86,400 ~= 2.3/sec
Peak (5x average):        ~= 12/sec
Bytes per day:            200,000 x 500 bytes ~= 100 MB/day
Bytes per year:           100 MB x 365 ~= 36.5 GB/year
caption: Deliberately rough -- round numbers, simple multiplication.

eyebrow: How scale changes which tools make sense
code:
36.5 GB/yr, 2-12 events/sec:   one KQL Database, no sharding needed
3.65 TB/yr, 2,000 events/sec:  sharding and partitioning start
                               to matter for real
caption: The same pattern doesn't automatically scale 100x.
